item.espresso_flavoured.lucky_bean.desc: +1 Luck: better fishing and chest finds
item.espresso_flavoured.thermos.desc: Coffee and cocoa effects last a quarter longer
item.espresso_flavoured.pocket_hearth.de: Powder snow can't freeze you, and you can walk on it
item.espresso_flavoured.reading_socks.de: Step up full blocks without jumping
item.espresso_flavoured.cafe_parasol.des: Fall 3 more blocks before it hurts
item.espresso_flavoured.knit_beanie.desc: Cozy heals you anywhere, not just near home
item.espresso_flavoured.ember_glove.desc: Smelts ores, sand, cobblestone and logs as you mine them. Crouch to mine normally
jade.espresso_flavoured.espresso_machine: Waiting for beans and a mug
espresso_flavoured.options.sugarCaneHeig: How tall sugar cane grows. Vanilla is 3.
jei.espresso_flavoured.water_lily.info: A lily pad in bloom. Use bone meal on a lily pad to make one, or look among the lily pads by rivers and ponds in new land.
Brews on top of a coffee bar
item.espresso_flavoured.bean_coin.desc: One for each Espresso advancement. A master barista takes them
espresso_flavoured.options.title: Espresso Flavoured Settings
espresso_flavoured.options.safeHomeRadiu: No monsters spawn naturally within this many blocks of your home bed (crouch and use a bed with an empty hand to set it).
espresso_flavoured.options.keepHotbarOnD: Keep your hotbar, armour and off-hand when you die. Everything else stays where you fell.
espresso_flavoured.options.creeperGriefi: Off: creeper explosions still hurt, but leave your builds alone.
espresso_flavoured.options.endermanGrief: Off: endermen leave blocks where they are.
espresso_flavoured.options.clock.tooltip: A day counter and clock in the top-right corner, right for the longer days. It turns gold in the hour before night.
espresso_flavoured.options.duskWarning.t: At 6:00 PM, an hour before night, "The sun's getting real low" appears above your hotbar.
espresso_flavoured.options.longerDays.to: 20-minute days and 10-minute nights. Takes effect after restarting the game.
espresso_flavoured.options.toughNights.t: A few more monsters at night, with a little more health and damage.
espresso_flavoured.options.phantoms.tool: Off: phantoms never visit, so sleeping is up to you.
espresso_flavoured.options.regenNeedsSat: Natural healing only happens when you have eaten recently.
espresso_flavoured.options.drowsiness.to: Become Drowsy after three days without sleeping at home, and Hungry if you haven't eaten in that time either.
espresso_flavoured.options.caffeineCrash: Coffee holds off Drowsy for up to a day, then you crash. Off: coffee holds it off as long as you keep drinking.
Seagrass and kelp, plants and flowers on the banks, moss, moss carpet and azaleas at the waterline, muddy banks where there's clay, and more firefly bushes and lily pads, in newly explored land. Takes effect after restarting the game.
espresso_flavoured.options.spawnGazebo.t: A little stone gazebo at the world spawn of new worlds, built from the wood that grows around it, with a spore blossom over a glowstone floor and the starter kit in its chest. Only takes effect when a world is created.
espresso_flavoured.options.protectGazebo: The spawn gazebo can only be changed in creative, and explosions, fire and pistons leave it alone. The chest, the benches and the pots still work. Turn off to remodel it.
espresso_flavoured.options.coffeeBarRequ: The espresso machine only brews on top of a coffee bar.
espresso_flavoured.options.bundleUnstack: How many tools or pieces of armour fit in one bundle (1 is vanilla). On a server, the server's setting is used.
espresso_flavoured.options.blockMerchant: The wandering trader also sells building blocks from far-off biomes.
message.espresso_flavoured.home_set: This bed is now your home. Monsters won't spawn within %s blocks of it.
message.espresso_flavoured.home_not_here: A bed can't be your home here.
message.espresso_flavoured.home_taken: This bed is already someone else's home.
